title: Research consultation
overview: Our Research Consultation service provides one-on-one methodological and technical guidance for UC faculty, students, and partner researchers—from initial topic framing and literature synthesis to research design, instrument alignment, and ethics readiness.
benefits: Clearer research questions and aligned study methodology
Faster, more structured literature review and synthesis
Fewer revisions during proposal, defense, and review stages
Direct guidance from experienced UC-IRPA researchers

components.title: Mentoring & Framing
components.text: Refine research problems, objectives, and scope with dedicated advisory sessions.

components.title: Literature Review
components.text: Guidance on academic databases, search strategies, and thematic synthesis.

components.title: Methodology Design
components.text: Select appropriate qualitative, quantitative, or mixed-methods frameworks.

components.title: Instrument Alignment
components.text: Align survey items, interview guides, and indicators with study objectives.

title: GIS services
text: Spatial analysis, GIS equipment, and GIS tools.
overview: Powered by UC-IRPA's GIS Innovation Laboratory, our GIS Services deliver end-to-end geospatial mapping, spatial modeling, and specialized field equipment support for hazard, watershed, health, and urban planning studies across the Cordillera.
benefits: Access to specialized GIS hardware, software, and lab facilities
High-accuracy hazard, land-use, and environmental mapping
Actionable spatial insights for LGUs, agencies, and planners
Hands-on technical assistance from UC-IRPA GIS specialists

components.title: Spatial Analysis
components.text: Hotspot detection, suitability modeling, watershed delineation, and terrain mapping.

components.title: GIS Equipment
components.text: Access to GPS units, mapping tools, and lab workstations for field studies.

components.title: Cartography & Mapping
components.text: Publication-grade thematic maps and visual layers for reports and proposals.

components.title: Field Data Integration
components.text: Clean, geocode, and integrate field surveys with satellite and census datasets.

title: Capacity building
overview: Our Capacity Building program equips faculty, students, and institutional partners with modern research, planning, and analytics skills through structured workshops, technical mentorship, and practical knowledge resources.
benefits: Hands-on training in research methods, GIS, and analytics tools
Practical whitepapers, guides, and institutional research templates
Stronger interdisciplinary collaboration across colleges and partners
Continuous capability growth for emerging and senior researchers

components.title: Workshops
components.text: Hands-on training in research writing, GIS workflows, and data analytics.

components.title: Mentorship
components.text: Connect with experienced UC researchers and program leads for guidance.

components.title: Whitepapers & Guides
components.text: Access curated research briefings, toolkits, and methodology references.

components.title: Networking
components.text: Build connections with academic, LGU, and industry partners at forums.

title: Statistical consulting
text: Statistical tools, research design, and validation.
overview: Our Statistical Consulting service provides dedicated quantitative advisory covering sampling design, hypothesis testing, instrument validation, and data modeling for academic theses, institutional planning, and externally funded projects.
benefits: Statistically sound sampling plans and experimental designs
Validated survey instruments with documented reliability checks
Accurate selection and interpretation of statistical models
Clear, publication-ready tables, diagnostics, and summaries

components.title: Research Design
components.text: Determine sample sizes, power requirements, and appropriate study designs.

components.title: Instrument Validation
components.text: Run reliability testing, factor analysis, and pilot validation checks.

components.title: Data Analysis
components.text: Descriptive, inferential, regression, and multivariate statistical modeling.

components.title: Statistical Tools
components.text: Guidance on software workflows, data cleaning, and assumption checking.

title: Proposal review
text: Technical refinement so proposals are funding-ready.
overview: Our Proposal Review service conducts a thorough technical and structural evaluation of research and grant proposals to ensure clarity, methodological rigor, and alignment with local, national, and international funding standards.
benefits: Stronger alignment with funding agency priorities and rubrics
Early identification of methodological, timeline, or budget gaps
Clearer problem statements, objectives, and expected impact
Higher competitiveness for institutional and external grants

components.title: Technical Review
components.text: Detailed feedback on rationale, methodology, and logical coherence.

components.title: Budget & Workplan
components.text: Verify line-item feasibility, deliverables, and realistic project milestones.

components.title: Funder Alignment
components.text: Tailor proposals to DOST, CHED, Erasmus+, LGU, and partner requirements.

components.title: Pre-Submission Polish
components.text: Final compliance check on required endorsements, forms, and formatting.

title: Research support
text: Publication and presentation subsidies for faculty, students, and staff.
overview: Our Research Support service administers publication incentives, conference presentation subsidies, and endorsement assistance so UC faculty, students, and staff can share high-impact research locally and internationally.
benefits: Financial subsidies for reputable peer-reviewed journal publications
Support for national and international conference presentations
Streamlined endorsement, processing, and documentation guidance
Greater institutional visibility for UC research and analytics outputs

components.title: Publication Subsidies
components.text: Support for article processing charges in indexed, peer-reviewed journals.

components.title: Conference Support
components.text: Assistance for accepted paper and poster presentations at scholarly forums.

components.title: Endorsement & Filing
components.text: Clear checklists and institutional endorsement for subsidy applications.

components.title: Dissemination Guidance
components.text: Advice on reputable venues, open-access options, and research impact.
